@@ -11,7 +11,7 @@ from starlette import status
 from starlette.responses import FileResponse, Response, StreamingResponse
 from starlette.testclient import WebSocketDenialResponse
 from starlette.types import Message, Receive, Scope, Send
-from starlette.websockets import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, WebSocketState
+from starlette.websockets import WebSocket, WebSocketDisconnect, WebSocketDisconnected, WebSocketState
 from tests.types import TestClientFactory
 
 
@@ -605,6 +605,56 @@ def test_receive_json_before_accept(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> N
             pass  # pragma: no cover
 
 
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+async def test_disconnected_websocket_operations() -> None:
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.disconnect", "code": 1000}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket"}, receive, send)
+    websocket.client_state = WebSocketState.DISCONNECTED
+    websocket.application_state = WebSocketState.DISCONNECTED
+
+    assert issubclass(WebSocketDisconnected, RuntimeError)
+
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnected) as exc_info:
+        await websocket.receive()
+    assert str(exc_info.value) == 'Cannot call "receive" once a disconnect message has been received.'
+
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnected) as exc_info:
+        await websocket.send({"type": "websocket.send", "text": ""})
+    assert str(exc_info.value) == 'Cannot call "send" once a close message has been sent.'
+
+    for state in (WebSocketState.CONNECTING, WebSocketState.DISCONNECTED, WebSocketState.RESPONSE):
+        websocket.application_state = state
+        for receive_helper in (websocket.receive_text, websocket.receive_bytes, websocket.receive_json):
+            with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnected) as exc_info:
+                await receive_helper()
+            assert str(exc_info.value) == 'WebSocket is not connected. Need to call "accept" first.'
+
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc_info:
+        await websocket.receive_json(mode="invalid")
+    assert type(exc_info.value) is RuntimeError
+
+    websocket.application_state = WebSocketState.CONNECTED
+    websocket.client_state = WebSocketState.CONNECTED
+    with pytest.raises(WebSocketDisconnect) as exc_info:
+        await websocket.receive_text()
+    assert type(exc_info.value) is WebSocketDisconnect
+
+    async def receive_invalid_message() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "websocket.connect"}
+
+    websocket = WebSocket({"type": "websocket"}, receive_invalid_message, send)
+    websocket.client_state = WebSocketState.CONNECTED
+    websocket.application_state = WebSocketState.CONNECTED
+    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError) as exc_info:
+        await websocket.receive_text()
+    assert type(exc_info.value) is RuntimeError
+
+
